_evidence: 0x004053ff reads the record dword +0x240 (test dword,0xffffffff; je 0x405481: zero skips straight to the store of 0, so it takes values with zero in about a third of the cases and both nonzero signs), word +0xba (movzx, imul multiplier, every value valid) and word +0xb2 (movsx, then cmp 0x200 / jge: values below 0x200, including negatives, are replaced by 0x200, so every value is a valid idiv divisor and both directions occur with a full-range draw); it writes word +0x176.
